en.sentence: This is a status notice; nothing needs to be done.

zh-Hans.sentence: 这是一条状态信息，无需处理。

en.sentence: The operation went on, but something was skipped, degraded or left uncertain. Please check it.

zh-Hans.sentence: 操作仍在进行或已完成，但有内容被跳过、降级或结果不确定，请留意。

en.sentence: The operation failed. Try again later; if it keeps failing, note the code and report it.

zh-Hans.sentence: 操作失败。请稍后重试；如果反复失败，请记下错误码并反馈。

en.sentence: This component cannot recover on its own. The installation, the system or another outside problem must be fixed before it can be used again.

zh-Hans.sentence: 该组件无法自行恢复，需要先修复安装文件、系统环境或其他外部问题才能继续使用。

en.sentence: The Runtime's receipt did not say where in the ledger this press was recorded, so the press is not confirmed as recorded. For a shutdown press, no shutdown request was sent.
en.handling: Press again. If it happens every time, make sure the console and the Runtime come from the same release.

zh-Hans.sentence: Runtime 的回执没有说明这次按键记在账本的哪个位置，按键未能确认记账；如果是请求关闭，关闭请求也没有发出。
zh-Hans.handling: 请再按一次。如果每次都这样，请确认监控台与 Runtime 来自同一版本。

en.sentence: A port in the ledger lists instances that have no binding facts, so port bindings are not shown this time. The event list is not affected.
en.handling: Reopen the console. If it persists, report it together with the Runtime version.

zh-Hans.sentence: 账本里有端口列出了实例，却找不到这些实例的绑定事实，因此本次不显示端口绑定；事件列表不受影响。
zh-Hans.handling: 请重新打开监控台。仍然出现时，请连同 Runtime 版本一起反馈。

en.sentence: The console's built-in routine performance-monitor event types do not match the Runtime contract, so the event list cannot be read while those events are hidden.
en.handling: Turn on Show Performance Monitor to keep reading. This is a console defect; please report it.

zh-Hans.sentence: 监控台内置的性能监视例行事件类型与 Runtime 契约不符，隐藏这些事件时无法读取事件列表。
zh-Hans.handling: 勾选「显示性能监视」即可继续读取。这是监控台的缺陷，请反馈。

en.sentence: The Runtime restarted or was replaced while the console was connecting to it or reading from it, so this read has stopped.
en.handling: Reopen the console to connect to the Runtime that is running now.

zh-Hans.sentence: Runtime 在监控台连接或读取期间重新启动或被替换，本次读取已停止。
zh-Hans.handling: 请重新打开监控台，连接当前运行的 Runtime。

en.sentence: The Runtime's instance status did not say which ledger position it was read at, so the instances' live status is not shown. The event list is not affected.
en.handling: Make sure the console and the Runtime come from the same release, then reopen the console.

zh-Hans.sentence: Runtime 返回的实例状态没有注明读于账本哪个位置，因此不显示实例的实时状态；事件列表不受影响。
zh-Hans.handling: 请确认监控台与 Runtime 来自同一版本，然后重新打开监控台。

en.sentence: The time span could not be read: page after page came back without an event, so the console stopped asking. The event list is not affected.
en.handling: Jump to the latest, or reopen the window, to read it again.

zh-Hans.sentence: 时间跨度没能读出：一页接一页都没有返回事件，监控台已停止追读；事件列表不受影响。
zh-Hans.handling: 可点「跳到最新」或重新打开窗口再读一次。
